description: This source file defines the ShapePlacementParsingStrategy class, which discovers and processes shape placement configurations from Placement.json files within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for loading placement data, filtering, and building placement predicates.

classes.name: ShapePlacementParsingStrategy
classes.description: A class that discovers shape placement configurations from Placement.json files and applies placement rules to shapes.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers enabled features and processes their placement files.

methods.name: ProcessFeatureDescriptorAsync
methods.description: Loads and deserializes placement.json for a feature if not cached, then processes its placement data.

methods.name: ProcessPlacementFile
methods.description: Processes placement entries, creating placement info and applying filters.

methods.name: CheckFilter
methods.description: Checks if a shape placement context matches the specified filter criteria.

methods.name: BuildPredicate
methods.description: Builds a predicate function for shape placement filtering based on a term and available providers.
